capability: Bound launcher handoff waiting to the managed child that successfully signaled readiness
searchEvidence: MainWindow reports READY and immediately calls zero-timeout VersionManagementExperience.InitializeAsync while the stable launcher still owns the exact state-path writer lease through its ready commit.
The ready adapter collapses missing inheritance, version mismatch, invalid handle, and write failure into bool false, so callers cannot safely qualify the only bounded-wait case.
All Settings and mutation paths already acquire with TimeSpan.Zero and must remain non-waiting.
semanticOwner: Application managed-child startup coordination over the inherited ready signal and exact state-path writer lease
terminalContract: Only an exact managed child whose inherited one-use READY write succeeds may wait at most five seconds for the launcher to commit and release the exact state-path writer lease, then reload durable state. Missing inheritance, mismatch, invalid/write failure, unmanaged startup, Settings, and mutations use zero wait.

designReview.evidence: The owner accepted the automatic safe fallback design. The reviewed invariant limits the five-second wait to a successful exact inherited READY signal and retains zero wait everywhere else.
